name: primitives-texts-gradient
title: Gradient Text
blurb: Text fills with an animated gradient.
description: Applies a multi-stop gradient to text with animation that shifts color positions over time, creating a flowing color effect.
use_when: Eye-catching headlines or premium branding elements.
avoid_when: Low-contrast environments or accessibility-critical labels — gradients reduce readability.
a11y: Text is readable but gradient may reduce contrast. Animation runs uncontrolled.
